title: Financial Analyst
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Provide data-driven recommendations to senior management on pricing strategy, inventory management, and resource allocation.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop strategic plans for new product launches and marketing initiatives.
 Prepare MIS reports to provide insights into sales trends, customer behavior, and market conditions.
 Conduct financial analysis on a monthly basis to track key metrics such as revenue growth, expense control, and profitability.
 Develop financial models using Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc. to analyze business performance and identify areas for improvement.

Key Skills: Financial Analysis,Financial Analytics,Analysis,Analytics,Finance
